Initiated a long term full mouth overhaul to include caps and dentures . Mid way thru the treatment was told the roots were too weak to be able to bite with the caps and they would only last 5 - 6 years . Once moved on to a fixed price , all agreed , all in , to the end plan , three treatments in got told the price would be increased by 25 % as they had forgotten part of the treatment . The thing they had supposedly forgotten being an item I had repeatedly mentioned and specifically highlighted in our conversations as it referred to the completion of a procedure that left the two teeth concerned weakened and unable to be used for biting .
We will be forgetting to go back and finalizing the treatments elsewhere
This place is great, very reasonably priced and very quick, I got a partial plate with 5 teeth, cast Monday picked up Friday for around $200 Australian
